summary: You can install PIM Manager on a private network, or make an existing install private, with the same two lines.

new.title: Private network with the same two lines
new.text: Add the private network option to the two install lines to install privately or to turn an existing public installation private. The database and registry get public access off.

new.title: Use your own network and hub
new.text: You can use an existing network in another resource group and peer it with your hub. Rights are checked first, and private DNS zones can be linked to the hub.
